harness.title: Robots reach volume by 2028
harness.hypothesis: General-purpose and industrial robots move from pilots to volume production by the end of 2028, and component suppliers show it in shipments before humanoid makers report robot revenue.
harness.why: Robot makers have to procure sensors, actuators and test capacity quarters before finished robots ship in volume, so supplier shipments and robotics segments should rise first.

tracking.must_hold: Hesai's robotics lidar shipments stay at or above their latest quarterly level.
tracking.if_late: No new quarter to read; robot sensor demand is unconfirmed.
tracking.if_against: Robot sensor demand is not compounding.

rules.say: At or above the FY2026-Q2 level (my judgment).
Between the FY2026-Q1 and Q2 levels (my judgment).
Back below the FY2026-Q1 level (my judgment).

tracking.must_hold: Teradyne's Robotics segment revenue holds near its recent high.
tracking.if_against: Industrial robot demand at the cobot layer is softening.

rules.say: At or above the FY2026-Q2 high (my judgment).
Between FY2025-Q4 and the Q2 high (my judgment).

tracking.must_hold: Tesla gives an Optimus unit or capacity figure, not only a production-start statement.
tracking.if_late: Humanoid volume is still a statement, not a number.

tracking.must_hold: Harmonic Drive's AI robot orders keep rising.
tracking.if_against: Robot maker orders are not following component shipments.

wrong_if.label: Hesai robotics lidar shipments below 100,000 units for two quarters in a row.
